content: NIST primary publications provide contingency planning (SP 800-34 Rev. 1), incident response (SP 800-61 Rev. 3, 2025), privacy risk management (Privacy Framework), and media sanitization (SP 800-88 Rev. 2, 2025) guidance. Jobot needs defined recovery objectives, tested restore/runbooks, incident ownership, and lifecycle treatment for backups; these are controls to adapt, not a compliance determination.
